scope: Controlled whole-device W; not normal-use or player-only power.
statisticalUnit: Complete four-leg block; 1Hz points are not independent repeats.
pooling: Only same APK/fixture/protocol/cohort/actual decoder/battery category/start 10-percent battery band/start 1C temperature band; never pool nights.
quality: Power, temperature, dropped frames, CPU observations and subjective quality are separate; frame hash is not subjective quality proof.
priorNight: Historical AVC playback position jump and Surfboard/WeChat state drift have unknown timing/causes; preserve prior evidence, no quantitative correction or transfer of old values.
deadline: New finite cutoff protocol; stop actual playback before 07:20, permit silent restoration afterward.
enabledRestoration: All selected package enabled states journaled; restore after unsuspend/unstop to preserve default-state values.

startupControlReassertion.cause: Unknown; no attribution to playback or quantitative subtraction.
startupControlReassertion.action: One reassertion of frozen enabled and force-stopped states; no control set or quality threshold changes.
